desc: A hamster-shaped spirit creature: round pale white body, black void face with two big white dot eyes, small gold ring earring, tiny lavender crystal on its back. Cute simple pixel art pet, chunky pixels, small chibi body, right-facing 3/4 view, full body centered, single dark outline, flat 2-3 tone shading, limited palette of lavender, pale white, deep violet and warm gold, no halo, no sparkles, no background, no ground shadow.
